title: ICHD-3 primary headache knowledge graph, Kleene reasoner and Gold-2 cases — reproduction package for the GMDS 2026 poster
description:
Reproduction package for the poster An ICHD-3 Knowledge Graph for Structured Classification of Headache Disorders: Development and Design — Primary headache disorders as machine-checkable rules (GMDS 2026). Contains the ICHD-3 chapters 1–4 rule graph (77 diagnoses) as a JSON bundle with a generator for the Neo4j Cypher script, the deterministic three-valued (Kleene) reasoner, the 2 616 graph-derived Gold-2 test cases, and reproduce.sh, which re-computes and asserts all 58 numbers printed on the poster without third-party Python packages.

Terms. Code: MIT. See LICENSE-DATA and NOTICE-ICHD3.md in the package.
